Product merchandising

Powering more complex products and attributesCopy link to clipboard

We’ve improved how all products, even the most complex, are listed and discovered on Shopify with the largest update to our product model in over a decade. From a new app for merchandising products that come in multiple colors and styles, to a new product taxonomy, and more.

We’ve improved how all products, even the most complex, are listed and discovered on Shopify with the largest update to our product model in over a decade. From a new app for merchandising products that come in multiple colors and styles, to a new product taxonomy, and more.

Product merchandising

Shopify Combined ListingsCopy link to clipboard

Products that come in multiple colors or styles can all be merchandised from a single parent listing, each variation with its own description, media gallery, and URL with the Combined Listings app. Exclusive to Shopify Plus.

Shopify Bundles

Bundles of up to 30 productsCopy link to clipboard

We've increased the maximum number of products you can offer in a bundle from 10 to 30. Merchants who use Shopify Scripts can now also use Shopify's bundle offering to increase their average order value.

Draft orders

Draft orders support discounts and metafieldsCopy link to clipboard

Drive more sales with support for discount codes, automatic discounts, and the ability to combine discounts in draft orders. Metafields from your draft orders will now also carry over to completed orders.

Discounts

New types of discounts to entice buyersCopy link to clipboard

Drive higher conversion with new types of discounts, including free automatic shipping and a fixed amount off of Buy X get Y promotions. Buyers will also see exactly how much they’ve saved right in the cart view.

Shop Pay

Supercharge any enterprise checkout with Shop PayCopy link to clipboard
